documents.title: Board Meeting Intimation for Quarterly Results For Quarter And Half Year Ended 30.09.2026
Disclosures under Reg. 29(2) of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011

analysis.summary: During the financial year 2025-26, GNA Axles experienced a 4% decline in net revenue to Rs 1,478.42 crore primarily due to export headwinds and US tariff impositions, while domestic demand remained robust, particularly in the tractor segment. Management focused on operational efficiency, cost control, capacity utilization optimization, and portfolio diversification into Light Vehicles, Passenger Vehicles, and SUVs. Profit after tax improved to Rs 116.99 crore, supported by enhanced operating leverage and lower cost structures. The company also expanded its rooftop solar capacity to 6 MW and incorporated GNA Mobility Limited to drive future product and capability expansion. GNA Axles Limited reported net revenue of ` 1,539.74 Cr and EBITDA of ` 210.61 Cr for the financial year 2024-25, alongside an EBITDA margin of 13.68%.

guidance.claim: Domestic tractor sales are expected to post a lower single digit growth in the current year.
guidance.quote: As far as the Domestic Tractor Market is concerned we expect that the domestic sales are expected to post a lower single digit growth in this year as the Country expects a good monsoon this year which is expected to increase higher farm incomes and a lift in the rural economy.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand for Commercial Vehicles is expected to improve from FY 2024-25.
demand_outlook.quote: With promising GDP growth outlook, incentives from government to improve productivity in both manufacturing and agriculture sectors, and continuing focus on infra, demand for CVs is expected to improve from FY 2024-25.

demand_outlook.claim: Management remains cautiously optimistic about domestic demand.
demand_outlook.quote: We remain cautiously optimistic about domestic demand while keeping a close watch on geopolitical developments, interest rates, fuel prices and inflation.

capex_expansion.claim: Management noted that GNA Mobility Limited was incorporated as a wholly owned subsidiary to expand presence in automotive components.
capex_expansion.quote: In 2025, we incorporated GNA Mobility Limited as a wholly owned subsidiary to expand our presence in automotive components.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that rooftop solar capacity was enhanced to 6 MW.
capex_expansion.quote: Enhanced our rooftop solar capacity to 6 MW

capex_expansion.claim: A 3 MW rooftop solar project is currently under execution.
capex_expansion.quote: Continuing this trajectory, a 3 MW rooftop solar project is currently under execution, reinforcing our dedication to expanding clean energy infrastructure.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to expand solar capacity further in 2024-25.
capex_expansion.quote: This year, we installed a 1.4 MW rooftop solar power project, and we’re planning to expand our solar capacity even further in 2024-25.

margins_costs.claim: The company achieved an EBITDA margin of 13.68% for 2024-25.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that total component manufacturing capacity was increased to 6.7 million components.
orders_capacity.quote: Increase in capacity to 6.7 Million components

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors recommended a dividend of ` 3 per equity share.

management_commitments.claim: The company is planning to expand its solar capacity further.
management_commitments.quote: This year, we installed a 1.4 MW rooftop solar power project, and we’re planning to expand our solar capacity even further in 2024-25.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
